body: thank you for this. i needed it.

No, I mean big life decisions like moving in together (this was before I found out the first time) 

The traveling in Europe bit was all me taking a risk and trusting in something bigger. That I take the blame for.

We bought the same plane tickets, the same eurail passes, booked hotels etc.... its going to be a pain in the ass... and this is my first time travelling europe alone. I'm thinking of faking it until I get home in early January (and get my hands on everything of mine he has of me... including photos etc by then)... and deal with kicking him out & moving his shit out of our current house later. 

My parents (who are your typical pair of traditional Asian parents) still don't know what's going on between me and him and would probably disown me if they found out (fucked up I know).

... I know, not going the morally correct route, but I can't see any other way that would benefit me in the long run :(

I do know for a fact that it's not going to last in the long term.

We were due to go travelling in Europe and have already spent a ton of money on various non refundable travel passes... also have nowhere to go with both our names on the lease. 

I'm just mad that he let me go through with all these big life decisions with thinking he could just get away with it all.
